# Project Design Context

## Project

- Name: lazisnu-monorepo
- Product type: nonprofit/charity management dashboard (LAZISNU)
- Stack: next@16, react@19, typescript, tailwindcss@4, pnpm workspaces

## Sources

- Tokens: apps/web/src/styles/themes.css
- Components: apps/web/src/components/ui
- Assets: assets, apps/web/public
- Instructions: apps/web/AGENTS.md, apps/web/CLAUDE.md, nopeAGENTS.md

## Components

- Installed: Badge, Button, Card, ConfirmToast, DropdownFilter, EmptyState, FilterPills, GlassDatePicker, GlassSelect, Input, Modal, PeriodPicker, Skeleton, Table
- Preferred primitives: apps/web/src/components/ui (custom, token-driven)

## Tokens

- Color mode: dual (light surface & dark glass), 15 themes via `[data-theme]` on `<html>`
- Canonical tokens: `--canvas`, `--surface`, `--surface-ink`, `--glass`, `--glass-ink`, `--primary`, `--primary-ink`, `--text`, `--muted`, `--border`, `--danger`, `--accent`, `--hover`

## Constraints

### Must

- Use theme tokens from `apps/web/src/styles/themes.css` (`var(--token)`) instead of hardcoded hex colors
- Support all 15 `data-theme` values; never assume a single light or dark palette

### Avoid

- Hardcoded hex/rgb colors in component classNames
- `transition-all` (animate explicit properties)
- `outline-none` without a `focus-visible` replacement

- None recorded
